migration_disabled_entry.description: The disabled OpenWrt (ubus) entry for `{host}` was migrated to the main entry. Subentries cannot be disabled; delete the `{host}` subentry to restore the previous off state.
migration_disabled_entry.title: Disabled router {host} was migrated

migration_failed.description: The OpenWrt (ubus) entry for `{host}` could not be migrated to the main entry. Delete and re-add the entry to complete the migration; its client trackers are recovered automatically.
migration_failed.title: Failed to migrate router {host}

migration_host_collision.description: The OpenWrt (ubus) entry for `{host}` was removed because a router with the same host is already configured on the main entry.
migration_host_collision.title: Duplicate router {host} was removed

persistent_invalid_credentials.description: The username and password for `{host}` are no longer valid, so the router cannot be queried. Use "Change router" on the `{host}` subentry to update the credentials.
persistent_invalid_credentials.title: Invalid credentials for {host}

yaml_import_cannot_connect.description:
The YAML configuration for OpenWrt (ubus) at `{host}` could not be imported because the connection failed.

Please check that `{host}` is reachable, update your `configuration.yaml` if needed, and restart Home Assistant.
yaml_import_cannot_connect.title: YAML import failed: cannot connect

yaml_import_invalid_auth.description:
The YAML configuration for OpenWrt (ubus) at `{host}` could not be imported because the credentials were rejected.

Please check the username and password in your `configuration.yaml`, then restart Home Assistant.
yaml_import_invalid_auth.title: YAML import failed: invalid authentication

data_description.consider_home: How long a client stays marked as home after the last router saw it.
